title: Reading a debt fund: monthly factsheet checks
objectives: Run the six factsheet checks and say what each warning sign means.
Explain why a sudden yield jump is a warning, not a win.
body_md:
YTM: a big jump vs peers or vs last month — a sharply higher yield often means lower credit quality or longer duration. Modified duration: does it still match the client's goal date? A dynamic fund may have lengthened duration. Rating mix: a rise in AA and below, or unrated paper, means credit risk creeping in. Top holdings: any single issuer above a comfortable share means one default could hurt badly. AUM trend: sudden large outflows can force the fund to sell good bonds first. Return vs category and benchmark over 1–3 years, after costs: one bad month is not a verdict.

| Check | What to look for | Why it matters |
| --- | --- | --- |
| YTM | Big jump vs peers or vs last month | A sharply higher yield often means lower credit quality or longer duration |
| Modified duration | Still matches the client's goal date? | A dynamic fund may have lengthened duration |
| Rating mix | Rise in AA and below, or unrated paper | Credit risk creeping in |
| Top holdings | Any single issuer above a comfortable share | One default could hurt badly |
| AUM trend | Sudden large outflows | Can force the fund to sell good bonds first |
| Return vs category and benchmark | Over 1–3 years, after costs | One bad month is not a verdict |

> **Investor takeaway:** Review a debt fund for what it holds, not just what it returned.
example: A fund suddenly far ahead of its category on yield is a red flag to investigate, not a reason to buy.
say: A sharply higher yield often means lower credit quality or longer duration.
One bad month is not a verdict.
never: A yield jump vs peers is always good news.
Factsheet checks don't matter if returns look good.

check.q: A debt fund's YTM is much higher than its peers'. What should you check first?
o: Whether it means lower credit quality or longer duration
check.why: Higher yield often means more credit or duration risk.
